generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample a value from the column's observed pool, coercing every sampled value with str() before any case/near-variant transformation; with probability 0.15 emit a near-variant (case change, truncation, one-character substitution, or appended suffix); NEVER emit NULL for NOT NULL columns and NEVER emit NULL for PK columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Sample uniformly from the explicit enum list in per_column_exceptions using str(v) for every literal; with probability 0.1 emit a case variant of a listed value; never emit NULL for NOT NULL columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Sample from the observed pool as str(v); with probability 0.2 emit a fresh near-duplicate (case/whitespace/typo variant) of a pool value.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Sample uniformly from the observed distinct values (floats); with probability 0.2 emit a value one step (1.0) outside the observed min or max; keep integer-valued reals as integers; store as REAL.
generic_sampling_rules.real_quantity: Sample from the observed distinct values; ensure at least two distinct values per group; with probability 0.2 emit a boundary value at min-1 or max+1.
generic_sampling_rules.primary_key_text: Generate a unique value per row: take a pool value and, when the plain value collides, append a unique numeric suffix; generate n + len(existing_candidates) candidate values and loop until the filtered unique count equals the target n; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.primary_key_real: Generate a unique numeric value per row: start from the observed pool (0..6) and add 1.0 increments for extra rows; generate enough candidates so that after deduplication the count equals the target n; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.foreign_key_text: With probability 0.15 emit NULL (nullable FK); otherwise copy a value from the parent column pool; ensure at least one parent row has no child and at least one child row has a NULL FK; apply the NULL rule AFTER primary-key and unique filtering so the NULL survives, or re-inject a NULL into a surviving row.
generic_sampling_rules.date_text: Sample from the observed date-string pool; with probability 0.2 emit a near-variant (one day earlier/later in the same format).
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column (all columns not declared NOT NULL and not primary key, including nullable FK columns), emit NULL in about 10% of the surviving generated rows with at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance. NULL injection runs after PK/unique filtering; a planted NULL is never replaced to satisfy a rule. NOT NULL and PK columns never get NULL.
